injuries.description: the injury was likely limited to the soft tissue.

injuries.description: a MRI of the lumbar spine was conducted on 30 September 2011 which shows that there was prolapse of intervertebral discs of L4/5, just impinging on the L5 nerve.

injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: pain upon standing (especially when getting up in the morning)
walking tolerance about 30 minutes with analgesic; instant pain when walking without taking medicine
sitting for more than one hour would lead to need to change posture
24‑hour numbness over the posterior aspect of the right thigh
impaired sensation of the whole right lower limb
tenderness in the right paraspinal muscles
loss of lumbar lordosis and mild degenerative changes at L3/4 on x‑ray

treatments_received: Right L5 Spinal Nerve Regional Block (SNRB)

losses.description: Back pain caused by the Accident
